AI Risks and Worker Displacement Concerns Emerge

AI company Anthropic has outlined potential catastrophic risks associated with artificial intelligence, including scenarios where AI systems could become uncontrollable. Separately, concerns are rising that a flawed AI strategy could lead to a "Talent Trap," potentially stranding millions of skilled workers. This "Turing Trap" suggests that an over-reliance on AI for certain tasks might hinder human skill development and career progression.
